spec.assertion: Structural: exactly one skill1 block, trigger hitCount count=30, target self, buff critRatePct value 9.28 durationSec 10, no durationShots. Event: every buffApply of critRatePct 9.28 is self-targeted (casterIdx===targetIdx===guillotine) with a FINITE expiresFrame. Totals: zeroing it lowers guillotine and leaves teammates byte-identical. Fails under the nearest-wrong models — critRateNormalPct rescope (asserted absent roster-wide), permanent/no-duration window (finite expiresFrame + durationSec===10), round-count window (durationShots must be absent), and any non-hitCount keying (see the 5:1 ratio test). Deliberately NO permanent-vs-10s totals counterfactual: at 30-round spacing the 10s window is continuously refreshed, so that A/B would be a near-no-op and would test nothing.

it.skip — v1 models no HP pool, so a self HP cost is unobservable and offensively inert on its own. Live guard: the 'no silent drop' audit test requires it (and the other HP lines) to be either modeled or recorded in unmodeled/note prose. Its only real significance is as the sole driver of the two HP-threshold lines below.

Structural: one skill2 block, hitCount count=150, target self, critDamagePct 14.69 durationSec 5. Trigger identity is proven WITHOUT any per-unit event field: this line and the 30-hit line share one hit counter, so count(9.28 applies) must sit in [5x, 5x+10] of count(14.69 applies) — a shotFired keying gives ~150:1 and an interval/fullBurstEnter keying gives an unrelated ratio. Duration non-vacuity: 5s is SHORTER than the ~150-round retrigger spacing, so the buff really lapses — stretching durationSec to 300 must RAISE totals, which is exactly what a permanent/refresh-locked mis-model would already have been collecting.

it.skip with reason: no HP-pool primitive, so 'HP lost' is unobservable and there is no threshold gate for it. Derivation recorded for the enactment recipe (⚑, NOT a measurement): the only HP-loss source in a fight where the boss deals no modeled damage is skill1's own 2.01% cost every 30 landed rounds, so <70% HP arrives after ~15 procs ≈ 450 landed rounds, entering at ~+28.8% ATK and climbing 0.96%/1% thereafter; whether the 2.01% is of Max HP or compounding on current HP is kit-silent. Live guard: the line must be modeled as an atkPct/casterAtkPct buff OR named in the override's unmodeled/note prose — silence fails.

Structural: a burstCast-triggered flatDamage atkPct 1237.5 in the burst slot. Behavioural: zeroing it strictly lowers guillotine's total (which simultaneously proves the fixture is non-vacuous for burst — she actually casts, because liter B1 + crown B2 chain her B3) and leaves teammates byte-identical. The block's target kind is deliberately NOT asserted to be 'enemy': the sim has no enemy entity, so that is an authoring convention rather than a kit-faithfulness claim.

it.skip (no HP pool → no gate primitive). Live faithfulness guard instead: HP starts at 100%, so this branch can never fire on the opening burst; therefore if the override ships >=2 copies of the 1237.5% flatDamage, at least one hosting block MUST carry a gate (formation/teamHas/mode/everyN/fbGate/ownBurstGate/resourceGate/...), and if it ships only 1 copy the skip must be recorded in unmodeled/note prose. A detector-non-vacuity run proves this matters: injecting an extra ungated copy measurably raises guillotine's total, so an always-on duplicate is not something totals would hide. ⚑ recipe if enacted: crossing 50% HP needs ~25 skill1 procs ≈ 750 landed rounds.

No kit line grants anything to an ally, so every block across the three slots must be target self or enemy — this fails if any line is mis-scoped to allies/alliesTopAtk, which would silently buff the team. Reinforced by the per-line teammate byte-identity checks on all five counterfactual runs.

fixtures: controlComp('guillotine', false) for every run — liter (B1) + crown (B2) + guillotine (B3). B1+B2 are mandatory because a lone Burst III unit makes ZERO full bursts and every burst/FB assertion would be vacuous. The fixed 4th B3 slot is dropped (helm=false) on purpose: that slot's ally Critical-Rate-of-normal-attacks grant lands on exactly the stat skill1 moves, which would both confound the crit A/B and risk pushing crit rate toward saturation, flattening the counterfactual deltas. Deterministic, no seed. 6 hoisted runs total (base, s1-crit-zeroed, s2-critdmg-zeroed, s2-critdmg-permanent, burst-nuke-zeroed, burst-nuke-doubled) plus one zero-run read-only override clone via withPatchedOverride(slug, () => {}) for all structural assertions. NOTE: this role had no write tools in-session, so the two artifacts (scripts/kit-autonomy/blind/guillotine.test.ts and guillotine.test-spec.json) are returned inline here rather than saved to disk.
